name: auto-code-saver
description: Per-document debounced auto-save with adaptive delay. No file watchers, no polling, no dependencies.

commands.title: Auto Code Saver: Save All Dirty Files Now

autoCodeSaver.delay.description: Milliseconds to wait after typing stops before saving.

autoCodeSaver.adaptiveDebounce.description: Shorten the delay after natural typing pauses (newline, semicolon, closing brace) so saves feel instant without saving mid-word.

autoCodeSaver.adaptiveDelay.description: Delay used when adaptiveDebounce triggers on a natural pause character.

autoCodeSaver.excludeLanguages.description: Language IDs to exclude from auto-save (e.g. markdown, jsonc).

autoCodeSaver.excludePatterns.description: Simple glob patterns (using * wildcard) to exclude by file path, e.g. *.log, node_modules/*.

autoCodeSaver.showStatusBarIcon.description: Show the Auto Code Saver toggle icon in the status bar.

autoCodeSaver.respectGitignore.description: Skip auto-saving files matched by the workspace's .gitignore. Adds a lightweight watcher scoped only to .gitignore files.
